question: Data Interpretation: Identify the CORRECT sequence of parent-subsidiary relationships regarding the newly incorporated AACL Global IFSC Ltd, as per the August 2026 report:

options.A: Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL) -> Adani Airport City Limited (AACL) -> Adani Airport Holdings Limited (AAHL) -> AACL Global IFSC Ltd
options.B: Adani Airport Holdings Limited (AAHL) -> Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL) -> Adani Airport City Limited (AACL) -> AACL Global IFSC Ltd
options.C: Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL) -> Adani Airport Holdings Limited (AAHL) -> Adani Airport City Limited (AACL) -> AACL Global IFSC Ltd
options.D: Adani Airport City Limited (AACL) -> Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL) -> AACL Global IFSC Ltd
options.E: Adani Airport Holdings Limited (AAHL) -> Adani Airport City Limited (AACL) -> Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL) -> AACL Global IFSC Ltd

rationale: Page 28 and 60 describe Adani Airport City Limited (AACL) as a step-down wholly-owned subsidiary of Adani Enterprises Limited (AEL). AACL incorporated AACL Global IFSC Ltd as a new wholly-owned subsidiary of Adani Airport Holdings Limited (AAHL). However, looking closely at Page 28: 'Adani Airport City Limited (AACL)... step down wholly-owned subsidiary of AEL... incorporated AACL Global IFSC Ltd... As New wholly-owned subsidiary of Adani Airport Holdings Limited (AAHL)'. Wait, if AACL incorporated it, but it is a subsidiary of AAHL, AAHL must be the parent of AACL. Page 79 says 'Incorporated by: AACL', 'Parent Entity: AAHL'. So the hierarchical flow places AAHL directly above AACL Global IFSC Ltd. The structure implies AEL is the ultimate parent, holding AAHL, which holds AACL, which incorporated AACL Global IFSC Ltd. Option C aligns with this corporate hierarchy.
